source: You are... Momo?#I'm glad you came here to save me...
target: 你是……莫莫？#很高兴你来救我……

source: I remember entering Terra Altar and fighting that#Underworld Queen, but I didn't find what I was looking for...
target: 我记得我进入泰拉祭坛，#和那位冥界女王交战，#却没找到要找的东西……

source: Instead, I was cursed as an Underworld Queen and became#the ruler of this forsaken shrine...
target: 后来我被诅咒成冥界女王，#成了这座废弃神殿的统治者……

source: I... I am sorry for everything I've done...
target: 我……我为所做的一切道歉……

source: I hope you can forgive me...
rdein: Thank you for playing.#This stage and the next are still incomplete,#so this is all I have so far!
target: rdein: 感谢游玩。#本关和下一关尚未完成，#目前只能做到这里！

source: Within the letter, words filled with love and joy became swarmingly#attached to your soul.
target: 信中满载爱意与喜悦的字句，#深深印入你的灵魂。

source: After reading it, the Love Letter vanishes into thin air.##Health boosted!
target: 读完后，情书化作轻烟消散。##生命值提升！

source: Now you can dash by double-tapping left or right.#Dashing lets you destroy blocks with a star symbol.
target: 快速连按左键或右键即可冲刺。#冲刺可击碎带星星标记的方块。

retain_reason: 保留原版游戏名及完整版权署名，保持大小写、年份与换行标记原样。

source: A strange crest is engraved here. It's sealed by some kind of power.
target: 这里刻着奇怪的徽记，#似乎被某种力量封印。

source: It's a seal you can throw pressing Up + S.#It's powerful enough to destroy certain kinds of blocks.
target: 按上键+S即可投掷印记。#威力强大，可击碎特定方块。

source:
The birth of an underworld queen is seen as a disaster to#people around the world.
Recently, a girl was cursed into one of these queens,#becoming the source of an imminent evil to the land of KoHo.
target: 冥界女王的诞生，被世人视为灾祸。#近日，一名少女遭受诅咒，#化作这样的女王，成为邪恶之源，#令科霍大地陷入迫近的灾厄。

source:
#As a maiden from the KoHo village, Momo's mission is to seal#the underworld queen from the forbidden ancient#shrine Terra Altar.
To reach the queen's throne and finish her mission, Momo#needs to pray to the 4 gods scattered across the shrine and#receive their blessing.
target: #身为科霍村巫女，莫莫奉命封印#禁忌古神殿“大地祭坛”中的冥界女王。#为了抵达女王的王座、完成使命，#她须向神殿各处的四位神明祈祷，#获得祂们的祝福。

source: ##But she is not the only one inside the temple.#Seeking the sacred powers from Terra Altar, other adventurers#wander around the ruins...
target: ##但神殿之中，并非只有她一人。#其他冒险者也在废墟间徘徊，#追寻着大地祭坛的神圣力量……

source: Hmm, so it's just a KoHo maiden after all...
target: 嗯，原来只是个科霍巫女……

source: I presume your mission here is to kill me, right?
target: 我想你是来杀我的，对吧？

source: Just go away.#You're so weak killing you right now wouldn't even be fun!
target: 滚开。#你太弱了，现在杀你都没意思！

source: Your seals can go through walls now!!
target: 你的印记现在能穿墙了！！

source: And just who are you now?#Get the fuck out of my way!
target: 你又是谁？#给我滚开，别挡路！

source: #...if you insist on being there, I'm going to beat you to a pulp!
target: #……你要是还挡着，#我就把你揍成肉泥！

source: #Reaching far-off distances, your prayers touch the hearts of the Gods...
target: #你的祈祷传至远方，#触动了诸神的心……

source: After running away from so many one-eyed freaks, I meet#a decent human.
target: 逃过那么多独眼怪后，#总算遇见个像样的人。

source: ...I'll definitely keep your name in my memory.#As for my name, it's Melko.
target: ……我会牢牢记住你的名字。#至于我，我叫梅尔珂。

source: I come from a very far away land, in search of the missing#princess from my country.
target: 我来自遥远的国度，#正在寻找失踪的公主。

source: Our princess' name is Eri. She supposedly fled the kingdom#after seeing the dreadful state of our citizens outside#the royal family...
target: 我们的公主名叫艾莉。听说她#见到王族以外子民的惨状后，#便逃离了王国……

source: I have heard people saying she came here looking for the#sacred powers hidden within, but where is she?#If you ever find her, can you bring her back here?
target: 听说她来此寻找神圣力量，#可她人在哪儿？#若你找到她，能带她回来吗？

source: Oh. There you are, Momo.#I'm sorry for speeding a bit, but#I had to make sure this place was safe for my little sister!
target: 哦，你在这儿啊，莫莫。#抱歉我走得快了点，#得先替妹妹确认这里安全！

source: You know, being on a mission like this isn't for any girl!#We trust that you'll find the Underworld Queen#of this shrine and defeat her.
target: 这种任务可不是谁都能胜任的！#我们相信你能找到并击败#这座神殿的冥界女王。

source: Ever since her appearance, we have been having problems#in our village...#Something must be done!
target: 自从她出现后，#村里就麻烦不断……#必须想想办法！

source: Well, I'll be heading home now.#I can't really stay with you here.#It's something you must do on your own.
target: 好了，我先回家了。#我不能一直陪着你。#这件事得靠你自己。

source: I hope you come back safe!#Good luck, sis!!
target: 希望你平安归来！#加油，姐姐！！

source: You got the Green Magic Leaf!
It's stronger than your Maple Leaf, and said to be able to purify even#the heart of an Underworld Queen.
target: 它比你的枫叶更强，#据说连冥界女王的心#也能净化。

source: You...You are annoying as hell!!#You better not appear in front of me again!!
target: 你……你真烦死了！！#别再让我看到你！！

source: Wait, you found Eri?!#...YOU FOUGHT HER?!!
target: 等等，你找到艾莉了？#……你还和她打了一架？！！

source: Ah... alright. It seems everything between you two#was resolved, then.
target: 啊……好吧。看来你们俩#已经把事情解决了。

source: Thanks for all this information!#As soon as I can I'll start looking for her!
target: 谢谢你告诉我这些！#我一有空就去找她！

source: Hey, Momo! How have you been?#I have been running away from all kind of despicable#creatures for some time now.
target: 嘿，莫莫！最近如何？#我这阵子一直在躲避#各种卑鄙的怪物。

source: I take it that you haven't found the princess of my land#yet... right?
target: 你还没找到我国的公主吧……#对吧？

source: Well, I've been constantly checking back the places I have#been, in hopes of finding clues of her disappearance.
target: 我一直回到去过的地方#仔细查看，希望找到#她失踪的线索。

source: If you find her, could you please tell her to go to where we#first met?
target: 如果找到她，能请她#去我们初次见面的地方吗？

source: It seems some kind of force prevents me from pushing#onwards...
target: 好像有股力量阻止我#继续前进……

source: So let be it.#My duty here is over, then...
target: 那就这样吧。#我的职责到此为止了……

source: Momo...#You are the only hope for my people and yours.
target: 莫莫……#你是我们两族唯一的希望。

source: Be careful, though...#Can you hear these screams of pain and agony?#It seems something or someone is in deep grief...
target: 但要小心……#你听见这些痛苦的哀嚎了吗？#似乎有人正陷入深深悲伤……

source: Maybe only you can free that soul from such pain. ##Good luck... and may the Gods be with you.
target: 也许只有你能解脱那灵魂。##祝你好运……愿诸神与你同在。

source: Oh, you again? I think you were from... KoHo, right?#Sorry, I forgot your name so I guess you're not one#to give a lasting impression.
target: 哦，又是你？你来自……科霍，对吧？#抱歉，我忘了你的名字，#看来你没给我留下印象。

source: Ah, Momo. Right.#I still haven't progressed much on my mission...
target: 啊，莫莫。对。#我的任务还是没什么进展……

source: But I hope you are doing fine on yours.#It doesn't really matter which one of us, or whoever#else defeats the evil from this forsaken place.
target: 不过希望你一切顺利。#无论是我们谁，或是其他人，#只要能消灭此地邪恶就行。

source: As long as that evil is gone,#we will all be able to live in peace again.
target: 只要邪恶消失，#大家就能重获安宁。

source: Ni hao...#My name is Mai.#I come from a far away land.
target: 你好……#我叫麦。#来自遥远的国度。

source: I am here for the same reason as you.#My people are threatened by the evil force coming from#this temple...
target: 我也为同样的理由来到这里。#神殿中的邪恶势力#威胁着我的族人……

source: For some reason I cannot get to the source of the evil,#though.#I wonder why...
target: 不知为何，我无法抵达#邪恶的源头。#真奇怪……

source: I can't believe how inefficient my kung fu is here.
target: 我的功夫在这里#竟然这么不管用。

source: Now you can jump mid-air by pressing the jump button!
target: 现在按跳跃键，#就能在空中再次跳跃！

source: Sup i'm the tol fairy!!!!!! placeholder dialogue wooooooooooooooooooooo
target: 嗨，我是托尔仙子！！！！#占位对白，呜呼呼呼呼！！！

source: The path ahead is too dark.#...You are scared to proceed.
target: 前方一片漆黑。#……你害怕得不敢前进。

source: You're in my way again!#What did I tell you about getting in my way!
target: 你又挡我路了！#我说过别挡路吧！

source: This time I'm going to be dead serious about#ripping your bones apart!!!
target: 这次我会认真地#把你的骨头一根根拆了！！！

source: Why...? I've lost to you again...!!
I'll be cheering for you!#So you can succeed your mission and keep#on bringing the good to the world!
target: 我会为你加油！#祝你完成使命，继续#为世界带来美好！

source: Just who are you...?#Are you looking for the sacred power#of this temple too?
target: 你到底是谁……？#你也在寻找这座神殿#的神圣力量吗？

source: What? Underworld Queen...?#I didn't know about such thing...
target: 什么？冥界女王……？#我不知道这回事……

source: I guess you are not an enemy, then.#I am Eri, princess of the Kingdom of Karst.
target: 看来你不是敌人。#我是艾莉，卡斯特王国的公主。

source: I'm here because of the many legends concerning#the miraculous power of this shrine.
target: 我为神殿奇迹之力的#诸多传说而来。

source: With such power, I could bring happiness#to everyone in my country.
target: 若能得到那股力量，#我就能让我国国民幸福。

source: The people of my kingdom live a terrible life, under#extreme conditions...#Those outside the royal castle are in deep grief.
target: 我国子民生活凄苦，#处境极其艰难……#王城外的人们深陷悲痛。

source: I fled from the castle the first time I saw#that sorrow with my eyes...#I couldn't stand it.
target: 第一次亲眼见到#他们的苦难，我就逃出王城……#我实在无法忍受。

source: ...Thanks for putting some sense to me.
Even though we are both fighting for our people,#you showed me how arrogant I am when compared to you...
target: 虽然我们都为族人而战，#但你让我看见自己有多傲慢……

source: Your name is Momo, right?#Just like me, you have people that trust you#and are waiting for your return...
target: 你叫莫莫，对吧？#和我一样，有人信任你，#也正等着你归来……

source: You are that KoHo maiden from before...#So you are really serious about killing me.
target: 你就是之前那个科霍巫女……#看来你真想杀我。

source: Oh well.#For reaching this far into the temple, you must be a worthy#opponent.
target: 哦，好吧。#能一路闯到神殿深处，#你确实是个值得一战的对手。

source: #Now get ready to be beaten to death!
THERNZ: I don't even want to be here.
target: THERNZ: 我一点也不想待在这儿。

source: KITET: Hey, hey. I'm a pushy fangirl.#Go finish making your indie game.
target: KITET: 嘿嘿，我是个热情粉丝。#快去把你的独立游戏做完。

source: Welcome to the Developer Room!#If you exit through the door the game will end,#so why not take your time here?
target: 欢迎来到开发者房间！#从门出去游戏就结束了，#不妨在这里慢慢逛逛？

source: RDEIN: I'm glad you made it this far... it means a lot to me.#Thanks for playing this game! I hope you enjoyed it!
target: RDEIN: 很高兴你能玩到这里……#这对我意义重大。感谢游玩！#希望你玩得开心！

source: ELEKTROBEAR: To plug or not to plug, that is the question.#www.elektrobear.com
target: ELEKTROBEAR: 插还是不插，这是个问题。#www.elektrobear.com

source: I'm glad you came here to save me...
Ever since I fought with that Underworld Queen...#something changed in me.
target: 自从我和那位冥界女王#交战后……我变了。

source: I couldn't bring my mother back to life... and instead I was#cursed into that monster you defeated.
target: 我没能让母亲复生……反而#被诅咒，变成你打败的怪物。

source: I... I am so sorry for everything I've done...
target: 我……我为所做的一切深感抱歉……

source: And so Momo's mission ended after fighting the Underworld Queen...
target: 莫莫与冥界女王一战后，#使命就此结束……

source: Peace would last for many decades in KoHo,#as new maidens kept training to protect the village.
target: 此后数十年，科霍重归和平，#一代代巫女持续修行，#守护村庄。

source: Being able to defeat that shadow...#That's really something.
target: 能打败那道影子……#你真了不起。

source: Well... I guess I have to take you seriously then.
target: 好吧……看来我得认真对待你了。
